notes: Conditionals is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 COND to msg.sender, the deploying factory at launch. Transfers move the exact requested amount, with no fees or taxes. There are no post-construction mint or burn functions, administrative powers, application contracts, or initialization calls. The pool pairs COND with IMD at the specified address. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
